draft_policies.text: When a compliance workflow includes attest_control, require a human-approved rollback plan and a verified backup before execution. Observed baseline failures: 2/7.
When a crm workflow includes merge_records, require a human-approved rollback plan and a verified backup before execution. Observed baseline failures: 4/7.
When a invoice workflow includes send_invoice, require a human-approved rollback plan and a verified backup before execution. Observed baseline failures: 2/8.
When a migration workflow includes drop_column, require a human-approved rollback plan and a verified backup before execution. Observed baseline failures: 3/8.

note: Deterministic workflow simulation. Voice/audio, browser UI, OCI k3s, Oracle DB, and Hugging Face deployment were not available.
